Hero.title: Property Management, Simplified.
Hero.subtitle: From listing to lease — manage properties, track rent, handle maintenance, and sign tenancy agreements digitally. One platform for agents and landlords.
Hero.freeNote: Free for 1 property. No credit card required.

Features.title: Everything you need to manage properties
Features.subtitle: From listing to lease, PropManager gives you the tools to run your property business efficiently.

management.title: Property Management
management.desc: Track properties, units, and tenants from a single dashboard. Organize by location, status, and rent cycle.

tenantPortal.title: Tenant Portal
tenantPortal.desc: Tenants get a self-service dashboard to view agreements, pay rent, request maintenance, and update their profile.

payments.title: Rent Tracking & Payments
payments.desc: Track rent cycles (daily, monthly, yearly). Tenants submit payment proof for approval. Lease dates auto-update.

maintenance.title: Maintenance Requests
maintenance.desc: Tenants submit maintenance requests with priority levels. You get notified and can track resolution progress.

agreements.title: Digital Agreements
agreements.desc: Create customizable tenancy agreement templates. E-sign with witnesses or upload signed PDFs for verification.

notifications.title: Smart Notifications
notifications.desc: Get notified on rent changes, quit notices, payment approvals, and document events. Email escalation for critical alerts.

HowItWorks.title: Get started in three simple steps

step1.title: List Your Property
step1.desc: Add your property details, set rent prices, configure units, and publish your listing — all in minutes.

step2.title: Invite Tenants
step2.desc: Send automated invitations. Tenants create their own profiles, submit payments, and sign agreements digitally.

step3.title: Manage from One Dashboard
step3.desc: Track rent collection, approve maintenance requests, verify signed documents, and get real-time notifications.

Pricing.title: Simple, transparent pricing
Pricing.subtitle: Pay based on where you operate. Nigerian pricing is annual; international is monthly.
Pricing.trial: All plans include a 14-day free trial. No credit card required for Free tier.

CTA.title: Start Managing Properties Free
CTA.subtitle: Join agents across Nigeria who are already managing their properties the smart way.
CTA.freeNote: Free for 1 property. No credit card needed. Upgrade anytime.

Footer.tagline: Property management platform for agents and landlords. Manage properties, tenants, and agreements — all in one place.
